summary: Read a non-negative integer n. Using n opening round brackets and n closing round brackets, find every arrangement that closes correctly. Correct closing means that, from the start up to any position, the running count of openers is never below the running count of closers, and the whole arrangement has equal counts. Write each accepted arrangement as its own text. The order among those texts is not fixed.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
